verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents private networking: each CKS cluster runs in its own private VPC, and VPC networking can be managed through Terraform and authorized with API access tokens. That covers the private-connectivity half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows how to expose ports or serve applications publicly from instances. Missing for 10: documented port exposure or public ingress/load-balancer capability, details on instance-to-instance private networking (subnets, peering, cross-cluster connectivity), independent or hands-on corroboration.
